description.value: The Dayton Audio SS18-22 Signature Series 18" Subwoofer is built for incredible low-frequency performance and extension in high-output systems. Engineered to deliver deep, accurate bass at extreme sound pressure levels, this driver combines a rigid anodized aluminum cone, dual spider suspension, and a massive triple-stacked motor system for uncompromising precision and control. Its 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former provides exceptional thermal stability, allowing it to reliably handle up to 1,300 watts RMS without compression. With advanced motor linearization and extensive venting, the SS18-22 is a powerhouse subwoofer ideal for high-performance home theater or music subwoofer systems where maximum output, low distortion, and durability are essential. Product Highlights Rigid anodized aluminum cone with indexed edge for pistonic accuracy and reduced resonance Aluminum shorting sleeve, ring, and pole cap ensure linear inductance and ultra-low distortion FEA-optimized motor with triple-stacked magnets delivers exceptional strength and symmetry at high excursion 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former for superior power handling and cooling Extensive venting through cone, pole piece, spider, and gap minimizes compression during long sessions Dual spider suspension with stitched tinsel leads for precise pistonic motion and extreme durability

model.value: SS18-22 18" Signature Series DVC Subwoofer 2 Ohms per Coil
